id: title:Gilbert09:validate uploaded file against selected format before upload

review.posthog_relevance: Adds runtime checks and user-facing error messages for spreadsheet file uploads, preventing unsupported formats from being uploaded and suggesting CSV/JSON/Parquet exports.
review.reason: The change implements a substantive, bounded capability: it adds runtime checks and user-facing error messages for spreadsheet file uploads. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H3 introduce the actual upload prevention and error display, while P1.F1.H1 adds tests for this behavior. This is not merely documentation or a narrow maintenance tweak, but a change to the upload workflow and user feedback.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on the assumption that spreadsheet upload prevention is a substantive improvement rather than a minor UX adjustment; without broader context on PostHog's file ingestion strategy, this remains a conservative assessment.
